title: The Drive Train Approach to Data Products
description: The drive train approach for building data products involves a systematic and structured process that includes data collection, storage, processing, model development, deployment, and monitoring. This approach allows companies to improve decision making, enhance efficiency, personalize experiences, optimize resource allocation, and gain a competitive advantage.
